Nikhil Singh Portfolio

Canonical: https://nikhil-index.netlify.app/
Description: Terminal-inspired portfolio for Nikhil Singh, a full-stack developer in Gorakhpur, India. The site highlights backend development, production web systems, selected projects, experience, education, and contact information.

Primary topics:
- Full-stack development
- Backend engineering
- Node.js, Express, MongoDB
- REST APIs
- Responsive web design
- Portfolio and client work
